propositions: rebar explain <guide|criterion> fails with missing-file when rebar is installed as a library/CLI/MCP against a consuming project lacking docs/ directory
explain_guide() and explain_criterion() currently read markdown via config.repo_root()/docs/, resolving to the consuming project's git toplevel instead of the installed package

Author guides (writing-a-passing-plan.md, passing-code-review.md) and criterion registry content must be accessible via importlib.resources from any rebar installation without dependency on consuming project layout
explain_criterion() must render criterion sections from the packaged registry via _guide_section_body while preserving overlay project criteria resolution via load_criteria(repo_root).
Pointer files must remain in docs/ to preserve existing links in docs/README.md and AGENTS.md without breaking reference resolution
